unit: 중1 L7 본문 — Let’s Make a Movie!
parts: 중1 L7 본문 — Let’s Make a Movie!
sentences: Hi, I’m Jim Brown, the director of Happy Days.
It’s a movie about the friendship between Tom and his dog Max.
A lot of people are working hard to create this movie.
Do you want to meet some of them?
I’m Anna, and I found this beautiful beach.
I’m a location manager, and my job is to find perfect places for shooting.
Of course, it is not easy, but I love my job.
I like to travel and enjoy challenges.
I’m Peter, the director of photography for this movie.
I’m in charge of all the cameras.
Today, Tom and Max are going to play together with a ball on the beach.
To capture their happy moments, I’m going to use drones.
I’m Jennifer.
I trained and took care of Max for a long time.
Max is a great actor, but he sometimes gets too excited when a lot of people are around.
So, I use hand signals to calm him.
Who am I?
I’m an animal wrangler.
My name is Emma, and I’m a film editor.
My work begins after the shooting is over.
To create a better story, I can change the order of scenes or delete some of them.
Storytelling skills are important for my job, so I read a lot.
I’m Chris, and I’m a Foley artist.
I create sound effects in my studio when recording on location is not easy.
Listen carefully.
Do you hear the sound of waves?
I made that sound with rice and a plastic container.
Doesn’t it sound real?

items.statement_ko: Jim Brown은 영화 Happy Days의 감독이다.
items.why_ko: 1번 문장에서 자신을 Happy Days의 감독이라고 소개한다.
_evidence_text: Hi, I’m Jim Brown, the director of Happy Days.
items.statement_en: The movie Happy Days is directed by Jim Brown.

items.statement_ko: 이 영화는 Tom과 그의 고양이 Max의 우정에 관한 이야기이다.
_evidence_text: It’s a movie about the friendship between Tom and his dog Max.
items.statement_en: The movie tells the story of the friendship between Tom and his cat Max.

items.statement_ko: 이 영화를 만드는 일에는 아주 소수의 사람만 참여하고 있다.
items.why_ko: 많은 사람들(A lot of people)이 열심히 일하고 있다고 했다.
_evidence_text: A lot of people are working hard to create this movie.
items.statement_en: Only a very small number of people are working on making this movie.

items.statement_ko: Jim은 영화를 만드는 사람들 중 몇 명을 만나보고 싶은지 묻는다.
items.why_ko: 4번 문장에서 그들 중 몇 명을 만나보고 싶은지 묻는다.
_evidence_text: Do you want to meet some of them?
items.statement_en: Jim asks if you would like to meet some of the people making the movie.

items.statement_ko: 이 아름다운 해변을 찾아낸 사람은 Anna이다.
items.why_ko: Anna가 이 아름다운 해변을 찾았다고 말한다.
_evidence_text: I’m Anna, and I found this beautiful beach.
items.statement_en: Anna is the one who found this beautiful beach.

items.statement_ko: Anna의 일은 촬영에 쓰는 장비를 관리하는 것이다.
items.why_ko: Anna는 로케이션 매니저로 촬영에 완벽한 장소를 찾는 일을 한다.
_evidence_text: I’m a location manager, and my job is to find perfect places for shooting.
items.statement_en: Anna's job is to take care of the equipment used for shooting.

items.statement_ko: Anna는 자신의 일이 쉽다고 말한다.
items.why_ko: 쉽지 않지만 자기 일을 사랑한다고 말했다.
_evidence_text: Of course, it is not easy, but I love my job.
items.statement_en: Anna says that her job is easy.

items.statement_ko: Anna는 여행하는 것을 좋아하고 도전을 즐긴다.
_evidence_text: I like to travel and enjoy challenges.
items.statement_en: Anna enjoys traveling and likes challenges.

items.statement_ko: Peter는 이 영화의 음악 감독이다.
_evidence_text: I’m Peter, the director of photography for this movie.
items.statement_en: Peter is the music director for this movie.

items.statement_ko: Peter는 모든 카메라를 담당하고 있다.
_evidence_text: I’m in charge of all the cameras.
items.statement_en: Peter is the person who takes care of all the cameras.

items.statement_ko: 오늘 Tom과 Max는 해변에서 공을 가지고 함께 놀 예정이다.
_evidence_text: Today, Tom and Max are going to play together with a ball on the beach.
items.statement_en: Tom and Max will play with a ball together on the beach today.

items.statement_ko: Peter는 행복한 순간을 담기 위해 헬리콥터를 사용할 것이다.
_evidence_text: To capture their happy moments, I’m going to use drones.
items.statement_en: Peter plans to use a helicopter to catch their happy moments.

items.statement_ko: 세 번째로 자신을 소개하는 사람의 이름은 Emma이다.
_evidence_text: I’m Jennifer.
items.statement_en: The third person who introduces herself is named Emma.

items.statement_ko: Jennifer는 오랫동안 Max를 훈련시키고 돌보았다.
_evidence_text: I trained and took care of Max for a long time.
items.statement_en: Jennifer trained Max and looked after him for a long time.

items.statement_ko: Max는 주변에 사람이 많아도 전혀 흥분하지 않는다.
items.why_ko: 사람이 많으면 때때로 너무 흥분한다고 했다.
_evidence_text: Max is a great actor, but he sometimes gets too excited when a lot of people are around.
items.statement_en: Max never gets excited, even when many people are near him.

items.statement_ko: Jennifer는 Max를 진정시키기 위해 먹이를 준다.
items.why_ko: 먹이가 아니라 손 신호(hand signals)를 사용한다.
_evidence_text: So, I use hand signals to calm him.
items.statement_en: Jennifer gives Max food to make him calm.

items.statement_ko: Jennifer는 직업을 바로 말하지 않고 "나는 누구일까요?"라고 먼저 묻는다.
_evidence_text: Who am I?
items.statement_en: Instead of saying her job right away, Jennifer first asks, "Who am I?"

items.statement_ko: Jennifer의 직업은 동물 조련사(animal wrangler)이다.
_evidence_text: I’m an animal wrangler.
items.statement_en: Jennifer works as an animal wrangler.

items.statement_ko: Emma는 영화 편집자이다.
_evidence_text: My name is Emma, and I’m a film editor.
items.statement_en: Emma's job is editing films.

items.statement_ko: Emma의 일은 촬영이 시작되기 전에 시작된다.
items.why_ko: Emma의 일은 촬영이 끝난 후에 시작된다.
_evidence_text: My work begins after the shooting is over.
items.statement_en: Emma's work starts before the shooting begins.

items.statement_ko: Emma는 장면의 순서는 바꿀 수 있지만 장면을 삭제할 수는 없다.
items.why_ko: 순서를 바꾸거나 일부 장면을 삭제할 수도 있다고 했다.
_evidence_text: To create a better story, I can change the order of scenes or delete some of them.
items.statement_en: Emma can change the order of the scenes, but she cannot delete any of them.

items.statement_ko: Emma는 이야기를 만드는 능력이 중요하기 때문에 책을 많이 읽는다.
_evidence_text: Storytelling skills are important for my job, so I read a lot.
items.statement_en: Emma reads a lot because storytelling skills matter in her job.

items.statement_ko: Chris의 직업은 폴리 아티스트(Foley artist)이다.
_evidence_text: I’m Chris, and I’m a Foley artist.
items.statement_en: Chris works as a Foley artist.

items.statement_ko: Chris는 현장에서 녹음하기 쉽지 않을 때 자신의 작업실에서 음향 효과를 만든다.
_evidence_text: I create sound effects in my studio when recording on location is not easy.
items.statement_en: When it is hard to record on location, Chris makes sound effects in his studio.

items.statement_ko: Chris는 독자에게 주의 깊게 들어보라고 말한다.
_evidence_text: Listen carefully.
items.statement_en: Chris tells the reader to listen with care.

items.statement_ko: Chris가 들리는지 물은 소리는 바람 소리이다.
items.why_ko: 파도 소리(the sound of waves)가 들리는지 물었다.
_evidence_text: Do you hear the sound of waves?
items.statement_en: Chris asks if you can hear the sound of the wind.

items.statement_ko: Chris는 그 소리를 쌀과 플라스틱 용기로 만들었다.
_evidence_text: I made that sound with rice and a plastic container.
items.statement_en: Chris used rice and a plastic container to make that sound.

items.statement_ko: Chris는 자신이 만든 소리가 진짜처럼 들리지 않는다고 인정한다.
items.why_ko: 진짜처럼 들리지 않느냐고 되물으며 진짜 같다고 자랑하고 있다.
_evidence_text: Doesn’t it sound real?
items.statement_en: Chris admits that the sound he made does not sound real.
